jcr:title: Infineon Solutions Products - Semiconductors, Microcontrollers, SoC
jcr:description: Explore Infineon semiconductors, microcontrollers, SoCs, & more for sale at Macnica Americas. These Infineon products are suitable for various applications.
keywords: Infineon robotics, Infineon healthcare, motor control, AIROC, OPTIGA, REAL3, MOTIX, AURIX, PSoC

text_1.text:
Infineon solutions bring a complete portfolio for system design, from motor control and power to sensing, connectivity, security, and memory. Macnica adds application expertise, reference designs, and hands-on support so you can move quickly from idea to pilot to production using Infineon semiconductors and microcontrollers.

  • Automotive excellence, safety, quality, and long-term supply
  • Robotics acceleration, motors, batteries, navigation, and security
  • Healthcare readiness, precise sensing, secure connectivity, low power

Infineon is a leader in automotive semiconductors for body, powertrain, ADAS, lighting, and in-cabin systems. Work with Macnica to map parts, accelerate design, and plan a secure supply program that matches your production goals.

text_2.text:
• AURIX and TRAVEO microcontrollers
  • OptiMOS and CoolMOS power, EiceDRIVER gate drivers
  • Automotive transceivers and networking
  • OPTIGA security for device identity and data integrity

text_1.text:
• Body and lighting systems
    TRAVEO II and AURIX MCUs for body control, LITIX LED drivers for exterior and interior lighting, CAN FD transceivers and system basis chips for networking and power management. OptiMOS and CoolMOS for efficient switching, EiceDRIVER gate drivers for robust control.
  • Comfort actuators, pumps, fans, seats, and closures
    MOTIX motor control, either XMC or PSoC Control C3 MCUs with external 6EDL7141 three-phase gate driver, or the integrated IMD701A option that combines XMC1404 with a 6EDL7141 driver in one package. Pair with OptiMOS MOSFETs and angle or Hall sensors for position feedback.
  • Battery management and 12-V sub-systems
    TLE9012 or TLE9018 BMS ICs for cell monitoring and balancing, TLI4971 current sensor for accurate current measurement, protection and balancing MOSFETs, plus EiceDRIVER high-side drivers.
  • ECU connectivity and security
    Automotive transceivers for CAN and LIN, OPTIGA security for device identity and firmware integrity, AURIX safety concepts for functional safety paths.

From service and logistics robots to cobots and mobile platforms, Infineon covers motor control, batteries, sensing, compute, connectivity, and security. The Infineon Mobile Robot platform gives you a fast path from demo to design, with reference hardware and software that shorten evaluation.

text_2.text:
• Motor control: PSoC Control C3 and XMC MCUs, 6EDL7141 or MOTIX IMD701A drivers, OptiMOS or CoolGaN power, EiceDRIVER gate drivers
  • Battery systems: Battery monitor and balancing, current sensing, protection FETs, CAN transceivers
  • Sensing and navigation: REAL3 hybrid Time-of-Flight, 60 GHz radar, angle and current sensors, MEMS microphones
  • Connectivity and security: AIROC Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, OPTIGA security ICs

title_1.jcr:title: Key Applications and Ideal Infineon Solutions:

text_1.text:
• AMR drive and motion control
    Choose IMD701A for a compact, fully programmable wheel drive, or use XMC or PSoC Control C3 with a 6EDL7141 three-phase gate driver. Add OptiMOS MOSFETs, EiceDRIVER gate drivers, TLE5012 angle sensors, and TLE9351 CAN for robust motion subsystems.
  • Battery systems for mobile robots
    TLE9012 or TLE9018 BMS for 12 to 18-cell packs, TLI4971 current sensor for accurate current measurement, protection FETs and high-side drivers, AIROC Bluetooth LE for service interfaces.
  • Navigation, obstacle avoidance, and SLAM
    REAL3 hybrid ToF navigation sensor for high-resolution depth at close range and room-scale mapping, 60 GHz XENSIV radar for presence and motion sensing in all lighting conditions.
  • Connectivity and fleet comms
    AIROC Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combos for reliable links between robots, infrastructure, and cloud services.
  • Edge compute and HMI
    PSoC Edge for ML at the edge and sensor pre-processing, PSoC 6 or PSoC Control C3 for control loops, timing, and fast ADCs.

Infineon enables medical wearables, patient monitoring, healthcare robotics, and lab automation. Pair low-power MCUs and precise sensors with secure connectivity and robust power to build reliable devices. Regulatory certifications depend on your end product, Macnica can help you choose components that align with your path.

text_2.text:
• Sensing: CO2 and pressure sensors, 60 GHz radar for contactless vital signs, magnetic and current sensors, MEMS microphones
  • Compute: PSoC 6 and PSoC Edge MCUs for signal processing and ML at the edge
  • Connectivity and security: AIROC Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, OPTIGA security for device identity and data protection

text_1.text:
• Patient monitoring and contactless vital sensing
    60 GHz XENSIV radar modules for heart and respiration monitoring without contact, PSoC Edge for signal processing and ML, AIROC Wi-Fi and Bluetooth for data handoff, OPTIGA Trust for device identity and data integrity.
  • Medical wearables and smart health devices
    PSoC 6 for ultra-low power control and sensing, AIROC Bluetooth for mobile pairing, secure boot and OPTIGA for protected data paths, pressure and magnetic sensors where required.
  • Air quality and facility monitoring
    XENSIV PAS CO2 sensors for indoor air quality, DPS368 pressure sensors for environmental or flow feedback, plus Wi-Fi or BLE for connectivity.
  • Lab automation and healthcare robotics
    Motor and motion subsystems using IMD701A or 6EDL7141 with XMC or PSoC Control C3, OptiMOS MOSFETs and EiceDRIVER gate drivers for compact reliable pump and actuator control.

title_2.jcr:title: Motor and motion control for wheels, pumps, fans, joints, and valves

text_1.text:
•  Use cases: AMR wheel drives, cobot joints, conveyors, HVAC fans, lab pumps
  • Ideal Infineon parts: MOTIX IMD701A motor control SoC, 6EDL7141 three phase gate driver, OptiMOS MOSFETs or CoolGaN where density helps, EiceDRIVER gate drivers, IPMs for compact stages
  • Add sensors: TLI4971 current sensing, TLE5012 angle sensing for FOC, Hall where appropriate
  • Tools: ModusToolbox Motor Control, FOC libraries, tuning dashboards
  • Sense: REAL3 hToF, 60 GHz radar, magnetic, current, pressure, MEMS microphones, CO2

title_2.jcr:title: Deterministic control and ML at the edge with low power

text_1.text:
• Use cases: Motor control loops and timing, safety islands, HMI, sensor fusion and local inference
  • Ideal Infineon parts: PSoC Control C3, PSoC 6, PSoC Edge for ML and sensor processing, XMC for motor control, AURIX when automotive safety or performance is required
  • Tips: Isolate control and communications tasks, size flash and RAM for models and logs, design for OTA updates
  • Tools: ModusToolbox, RTOS options, ML toolchains and examples

title_2.jcr:title: Reliable links within devices and across fleets

text_1.text:
• Use cases: Fleet telemetry, OTA updates, service BLE pairing, vehicle and facility networks, USB device attach
  • Ideal Infineon parts: AIROC Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combos, CAN and LIN transceivers, USB-C PD controllers, EZ-USB bridges, isolation for noisy domains
  • Tips: Reserve antenna keep-outs and ground, validate coexistence early, define PD power profiles and cable behavior
  • Tools: Connectivity stacks, certification test guides, antenna layout notes

title_2.jcr:title: Device identity, authentication, and protected firmware

text_1.text:
• Use cases: Secure boot and update, device attestation, cloud onboarding, accessory and battery pack authentication
  • Ideal Infineon parts: OPTIGA Trust and Authenticate families, TPM where required by platform policy
  • Tips: Define PKI and provisioning flows early, align security with OTA and manufacturing tests
  • Tools: OPTIGA host libraries, example flows and integration notes

title_2.jcr:title: Depth, presence, position, current, pressure, and acoustic sensing

text_1.text:
• Use cases: Obstacle detection, contactless vital signs, encoderless position, air quality, acoustic classification
  • Ideal Infineon parts: REAL3 hybrid ToF, XENSIV 60 GHz radar, XENSIV magnetic angle sensors, TLI4971 current sensors, DPS368 pressure, digital MEMS microphones, PAS CO2
  • Tips: Plan FOV and range early, budget for shielding and calibration, use sensor fusion to improve confidence
  • Tools: Sensor SDKs, data logging utilities, depth and radar visualization tools
